antimode_search.method: largest interior gap in the sorted log10 ratio, edges trimmed 5% each side
antimode_search.note: gap_over_median >> 1 indicates the cut sits in a genuine antimode rather than being imposed

geographic_coherence.note: near-perfect split at about 20-21 S, but derived from the physical ratio rather than imposed as a latitude cut

caveats: The ratio depends on GLORYS12 surge, which may be underestimated on the wide shallow Amazon shelf; the partition is conditional on the model and cannot be verified without tide gauges (AUD-18).
Bimodality may be partly amplified by uneven grid-point sampling along a convoluted coastline, though the sharp spatial transition near 21-22 S has a physical basis in shelf geometry.
The partition does not fully resolve AUD-02: some low wave thresholds survive inside the retained domain.
